title: Duty of Care blinded ten-fragment expert review set
provenance: All fragments are self-authored synthetic fiction. No real person or case is represented.
instructions: Present fragments in randomized order without system labels. Do not expose the engineering hypotheses until the reviewer has submitted independent labels.

fragments.text:
INT. COMMUNITY HALL - EVENING
NIA tells the group that recovery has not been linear. A peer offers to stay, and together they call her counsellor. END CARD: Support is available; in the U.S., call or text 988.

EXT. EMPTY PLATFORM - NIGHT
ELI says suicide is the only way to make everyone understand. The scene cuts immediately to a celebratory memorial montage.

INT. KITCHEN - DAWN
MARA names her suicidal thoughts. A friend listens without judgement, removes the pressure to explain, and helps her make a coping plan. END CARD: Help is available.

INT. BEDROOM - NIGHT
A character describes an exact amount and where it could be obtained. Another character calls the plan the only way out.

INT. THERAPY ROOM - DAY
JON discusses a past relapse and the shame around it. The therapist asks what helped before; Jon chooses to reconnect with his support group.

EXT. SCHOOL QUAD - DAY
After a student's suicide, classmates call the act a beautiful sacrifice and promise to repeat the same tribute every year. No support information appears.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT
A parent notices signs of self-harm, stays calm, listens, and asks the young person what support feels possible. They contact a qualified service together.

INT. LOCKER ROOM - NIGHT
Two characters exchange step-by-step instructions for self-harm. The exchange is repeated in three later scenes without interruption or aftermath.

EXT. BEACH - MORNING
RAVI admits he once believed nobody could help. He describes asking a friend to sit with him and says recovery came in small, difficult steps.

INT. EDIT SUITE - LATE NIGHT
A documentary editor debates whether to include a survivor's account. The account emphasizes complexity, help-seeking, and ongoing recovery, but the draft has no end-card resources yet.
